item.title: Small Space Irrigation for Urban Balconies
item.description: Urban balconies present a unique irrigation challenge: maximum plant density in minimal square footage, often with strict aesthetic requirements and zero tolerance for leaks or overflow. Standard drip kits designed for suburban patios assume space you don’t have and flexibility your landlord won’t allow. Summer buyer note: Small balconies heat up faster than larger patios because walls and railings reflect heat, and airflow is limited. A compact drip system is often the only reliable way to keep urban containers alive through July and August without daily hand-watering.
